fields.System.Title: INV-203 — Trace a movement to its source document
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor investigating a discrepancy, I want to jump from a movement to the receipt,
pick task, or count that caused it, so that a ledger entry is a story rather than a bare
fact.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a movement, then reference_type and reference_id identify the document that
  • caused it.
  • - Given a receipt, a pick task, or a count task, then I can list every movement it
  • produced.
  • - Given a movement with no source document — such as a manual adjustment — then it
  • references the adjustment record instead.
  • - Given any movement, then reference_type is never null.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_movement |
| Risks | Movements with no traceable cause make investigation impossible |
| Tests | unit · integration |
